Zara: Kicked off a canary for v2026-08-01 at 5% in eu-central per change window. Holding for 12m quiet.
Ken: Watching latency and embeddings quality. Will call stop if p95 > 3x or embeddings drift > 3%.
ops-bot: ALERT: canary-euc p95 rose 110ms -> 420ms at T+4m. 5xx stable.
Ravi: Traces show one host euc-host-04 with repeated short GC stalls and higher kv-evict.
Zara: Prefer a host-exclude routing override first to preserve canary telemetry. If routing fails or error budget >25% we rollback. Agreed?
Ken: Agreed. Apply routing override and extend hold to 30m if stable.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: route-override apply --selector canary:v2026-08-01 --exclude-hosts euc-host-04 --until 4876547000 --reason "noisy-host-gc"
deploy-bot: status: job rchg-2201 started
ops-bot: INFO: rchg-2201 progress: 2/3 updated, 1 retry pending
Ken: One instance timed out applying change; retrying now.
deploy-bot: status: rchg-2201 completed at 4876543275: 3/3 success
Ken: p95 back near baseline ~125ms. KV eviction falling. No 5xx increases.
Zara: Good. I'm annotating release notes: "Extended canary window due to transient host GC; routing override applied; no rollback." Also adding follow-up: mark euc-host-04 for drain and reprovision.
Ravi: Opening INC-8015 to reprovision euc-host-04 and reduce compaction frequency.
ops-bot: NOTE: canary hold extended until 4876549000 per update.
Zara: We'll resume gradual ramp after 30m quiet. Closing thread unless regression observed. :thumbsup:
